description: This file defines the AutoCompleteRequest class used for constructing JSON requests related to autocomplete functionality in the web shop, specifically generating JSON strings with query and type info, and building collection names based on merchant and language codes.

classes.name: AutoCompleteRequest
classes.description: A class that represents an autocomplete request, capable of generating JSON payloads and providing collection naming based on merchant and language codes.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for a given query, structured for autocomplete matching.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Builds and returns a collection name string based on keyword, language, and merchant codes.
